answer: Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond on a public ledge prior to voting, and every epoch a randomized pulse challenges agents to reveal a fresh pearl—a unique proof-of-work nonce tied to their bond. Duplicating identities means posting a separate bond per fake agent and solving each pearl independently, so an attacker's cost scales linearly with the number of sybils while honest agents pay once.
